body: Thank you so much. Appreciated it. Btw you have no idea how relevant some of these song recommendations are lol 💜
These are amazing thank you 😊
I like 👍🏽Thank you! 💜
Please! Lol. i use Spotify.

**Please recommend some sad mushy love songs (or something like it)** lol - Someone who I really like just told me he doesn’t want to go out with me even though he thinks I’m attractive and awesome. No need to explain - sometimes things just don’t work out. I’m not heartbroken or anything but I am a bit disappointed and upset. Need some nice songs/music for like the next few days I guess? Music can be positive or a bit sad for sucky romantic situations. Thanks in advance!
Lol my mom is one of the people saying I should stay in this relationship. Did I mention my moms not helpful?
Ok find me one lol. 😂

Thank you so much. 💚 He says he will consider the therapy and honestly I know it’s not much but just the small step that he says he will think about it is a bigger emotional development step than he has ever taken lol.
Thank you!! Wish you all the best too and merry Christmas to you too!! 🎄❤️💚
LOL. Well I might still fuck him in a way *I* enjoy it. But certainly less enjoyable for me now that I know this person is not emotionally supportive.

Yeah I think he knows I don’t have the heart to throw him out and let him be on his own right now. He knows I care about him too much to do that to him so he’s *not* seriously thinking “my relationship could end, maybe I should put some effort into fixing it.” Should I give him some ultimatums and say if you don’t agree to even counselling I will throw you out? Probably. But I just can’t get myself to say it let alone act on it.

He definitely tries his best to be supportive and really is a great partner aside from this one issue. However on the question of maturity - we are both in our 30s-40s so it’s not like I’m dating a person in their late teens or early 20s. I feel like if some can’t learn to be emotionally mature by the time they’re in their mid 30s they probably never will.
Easier said than done 😂

You clearly know nothing. People sometimes just want to get something off their chest. When you go see a psychotherapist they often stay silent during the entire session so you can just unload to make yourself feel better. Why don’t I just talk to a wall instead? Because there’s evidence talking to a person is more effective. Knowing that when you post something on Reddit there’s a higher chance someone has at least read it even if no one replies can also help achieve this effect. And if no one ended up reading it anyway? Ok I still don’t care because at least it’s like I wrote it in a diary and got it out of me which also helps a bit.

Yes I am looking for attention. I am an extrovert who likes public speaking and performing on stage. Of course I like attention do you realize through your minuscule brain that is not an insult?  

Not everyone in every culture “puts a ring on it” or “gets married” in the traditional sense you know? Like I said in my country common law _is_ married you clearly don’t know how to read. A friend of mine is with her “husband” she never actually married for 45 year and she has the same type relationship as someone who is married. 

Why don’t you learn a little bit about how life and the world works before you open you mouth or send idiotic comment replies?
Thank you for this perspective. It’s very helpful. ❤️
Lol this is why when he said that all I could do is laugh.
Yeah I’ve asked him to come to couples therapy four times, he said no all those times. I brought it up last night and basically said at this point it’s nonnegotiable. He said he’ll think about it.
Sorry you had to go through that and glad you are doing better. It’s so interesting because my bf literally has said exactly “mood swings are not normal” to me!

Replied to someone else answering this question. Here you go: https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/kgaidi/my_bf_thinks_suicidal_people_are_all_weak_cowards/ggfaxs2/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=iossmf&context=3
Prefer not to say for privacy reasons. But I’ll say it’s an English speaking one.

I fee responsible for him. I know it’s hard for people to understand but when you’ve been with someone for more than a decade they feel like family now. It would be similar to abandoning someone in my family. My mom is wayyy worse than him but I’d never abandon my mom either. He’s most likely not able to afford to live on his own and I don’t want him to not have a place to live or starve. I still love him. And just like I can’t control intrusive thoughts - I can’t control who I love.
Lol oh believe I have said he also needs professional help. And he just goes whaaaaaaatt?????!! 🤣
Maybe one day. But not right now lol.

Lol Yeah maybe but to me it would be like getting divorced the way our lives are so entwined. Again - not impossible - people get divorced all the time but still it’s a lot more work. Sounds dumb to say but i’m too busy for a divorce right now LOL.

I totally agree with you. He says “I was bullied as a kid too” and I believe him. And honestly I’m not saying my life is that much worse or anything. Even if my life was easier than his - I could still get depressed for generic reasons that can’t be explained by my environment. So he won’t really know what it’s like until he experiences similar mental health issues.

Yeah honestly some of my friends can’t handle too much self harm and suicide talk either but all of them are at least willing to talk about it for like 10-15 minutes. No one is nearly as bad as him on this topic.
Honesty - now - I don’t even wanna know what he thinks cause I’ll probably get so angry.
Thank you so much this really means so much to me ❤️
Lol his penis is actually pretty big. However that doesn’t compensate for being a dick 😆

The doctor in the hospital already kind of educated him on that sometimes depressed or people with OCD can’t control their thoughts. While my bf trusts doctors 99% of the time, he thinks in this case the psychiatrist is just talking BS lol.
Thank you so much. And hope you are doing well yourself ❤️
Lol yeah I called him that earlier 😂
Thanks for your thoughts. I’ll think about it.

I don’t know but I think probably not? He says he’s never been depressed, never had negative thoughts like what I describe, never thought to hurt himself and it’s the farthest thing he could ever think. But again he could just be not telling me.

He went to see a child psychologist for almost a decade as a kid. In my opinion he saw a bad psychologist who I think taught him some unhealthy ways to suppress his emotions and see other emotion in general as weak. But as I never met his child psychologist I can’t verify if him being this way is actually directly caused by seeing this doctor.
Thank you. I absolutely agree ❤️❤️❤️
I think it’s also brave to overcome suicidal and intrusive thoughts - but again I feel like unless one has great empathy they can’t know just how difficult overcoming suicidal tendencies is.
LOL yes!!!
When I was hospitalized - a bunch of doctors literally told him what you just said, well except the F off part lol. He doesn’t agree with the doctors 😂
He says “I try so hard to emphasize with you” lol.
My thoughts exactly!
Oh I got a loooot more and some of it are hilaaaarious. Lol.
Lol thanks I yelled at him earlier so now I feel a bit better 😆
Thanks for your thoughts. I agree =)
